messages:
ajay: Quick heads up — runbook infra/incident-runbook images are returning 503 on staging.
ajay: Hit this while testing the oncall flow, steps below.
ajay: curl -I https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/infra/incident-runbook.png
ajay: got 503 consistently. Anyone owns that runbook?
docs-bot: automated scan found 3 image URLs returning 5xx and created suggestion: https://git.redwood.ai/docs/patch/1234 :robot_face:
maria: I can take ownership and patch the broken shortlinks, thanks for pinging @ajay. I'll try a quick rehost to S3 and update references.
lina: thanks @maria — quick note, this runbook is localized (ja/fr). If you rehost make sure relative paths remain stable or we break staging previews.
kelvin: FYI infra changed the public assets bucket policy yesterday; might be related. @maria if you need a temporary ACL we can open it for the PR run.
maria: ok, will rehost to s3://redwood-docs-temp and push a small PR. sed replace I plan:
```
# replace /assets/cdn/... with https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-docs-temp/
sed -E 's|https?://[^/]+/assets/cdn/|https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-docs-temp/|g' -i runbooks/*.md
```
maria: opening PR now — https://git.redwood.ai/docs/pulls/589
maria: small change, only image URLs and one alt fix.
kelvin: quick security check: ensure the S3 objects are public-read only for the short-lived bucket, we can delete after validation.
lina: I'll run a staging preview once PR is up and check localized pages. ping me for review.
ajay: leaving a CR ping — @lina @kelvin can you review after maria opens? I want this in before the oncall drills tomorrow.
maria: PR opened and I added the migration note in the PR body. cc @lina for localization, @kelvin for ACL.
docs-bot: staging preview created: https://staging-previews.redwood.ai/preview/589 :white_check_mark:
lina: preview looks good, images render in en/ja/fr. minor alt copy suggestion in PR.
kelvin: ACL looks OK for the preview. removing public-read after we merge is fine.
ajay: awesome — if we can get one review and merge today, we'll be set.
maria: merged and deleted temp bucket. Thanks all :tada:
ajay: confirmed oncall docs load in staging. closing the loop. :thumbsup:
